portfolio_comparison.reason: The remaining capability is a conventional permission-aware legal RAG assistant with citation verification. It improves research productivity but does not introduce a materially distinct actor, bounded decision, integration boundary or measurable outcome beyond existing evidence-grounded legal and regulatory patterns.

existing_landscape.summary: Adopt a current legal-research or enterprise RAG platform with authoritative-source controls, private matter collections, citation audit and mandatory lawyer verification. Keep procedural deadlines and filing requirements in deterministic workflows represented by PROF-001.

research.findings: Receita Federal guidance confirms that e-Processo already centralizes case status, history, communications, notices and document submission under controlled representation. A 2026 Brazilian Portuguese legal RAG publication reports a production pipeline using hybrid retrieval, reranking and post-generation citation audit, showing that the core technical pattern is already available and that citation fidelity remains the central control rather than a new solution opportunity.
